events.title: Federal Reserve Interest Rate Decision
events.summary: The Federal Reserve is set to make its interest rate decision, which could significantly impact the economy. Experts predict a potential rate hike due to high inflation. This decision will influence the stock market and currency exchange rates.

Buying the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) could provide a hedge against potential losses, while shorting the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) could capitalize on potential bond market declines.
